description: Find local Flipp flyer deals, coupons, and grocery savings by ZIP or postal code.

tools.name: flyers_data
tools.description: Fetch the combined local flyer and coupon data payload. Optional: zip (default: 85001), locale (default: en-us). Returns the FlyerDataResponse.

params.name: zip
params.description: ZIP or postal code used to find local flyer and coupon data

params.name: locale
params.description: Flipp locale for the combined data payload

tools.name: flyers_items
tools.description: List item clippings from a specific flyer. Required: flyer_id. Optional: sid (default: 1234567890123456), locale (default: en). Returns array of FlyerItem.

params.name: sid
params.description: 16-digit Flipp session identifier accepted by flyer item endpoints

tools.name: flyers_list
tools.description: List active flyers for a ZIP or postal code. Optional: zip (default: 85001), locale (default: en-us). Returns the FlyersResponse.

params.name: zip
params.description: ZIP or postal code used to find local flyers

tools.name: items_search
tools.description: Search local flyer and ecommerce deals by keyword. Required: q. Optional: zip (default: 85001), locale (default: en-us), sort. Returns the SearchResponse.

params.name: q
params.description: Item keyword to search for, such as milk, eggs, or coffee

params.name: zip
params.description: ZIP or postal code used to find local Flipp results

tools.name: location_by_ip
tools.description: Detect the current public IP location as a Flipp postal code. Returns the LocationInfo.

tools.name: merchants_list
tools.description: List Flipp merchants available for a ZIP or postal code. Optional: zip (default: 85001), locale (default: en-us). Returns the MerchantsResponse.

params.name: zip
params.description: ZIP or postal code used to find relevant merchants
